title: Mutation lane drives env_drift --all on every cell mutant, though its capture never executes 681 of the 1260 unpinned sites
claim: Of the 1260 unpinned inventory sites in the D3-s1 cell files, 681 lie on executable lines that env_drift.py's only production-executing step (the `--capture <tree> <out> --all` child) never executes, yet tests/mutation_table.py's reach rule can skip env_drift for none of them (gate_skippable=0), so every such mutant pays a full `env_drift.py --all` golden capture that cannot change.
mechanism: env_drift.py starts its capture child with `env["PYTHONPATH"] = <tree>/tests/hastub` (tests/env_drift.py, the capture loop in main), which drops the reach hook's directory, so the child leaves no reach record (processes started 3, recorded 1); the parent also starts git/file/uname. mutation_table.reach_problems refuses any run that starts a non-Python process or loses a record, so env_drift's reach row is never usable and reach_skip never skips it.

evidence.unit: unpinned cell sites whose line the env_drift --capture --all child never executes, all still driven (gate_skippable=0)
evidence.contention_note: Counts are contention-immune. The traced baselines were taken while another D3 seat (D3-s3), verifier seats and the orchestrator's beat jobs ran on this machine (load1 30-300); the env_drift wall quoted (602.8 s for one --all run) is provisional. Re-run on box D3R (box D3R: Linux x86_64, nproc 4, Intel Xeon @ 2.10GHz, venv-ci CPython 3.14 (numpy 2.5.4, scipy 1.18.1), alone on the box, load1 0.2-4.2) on traced baselines re-taken there: capture_never_executes=681, gate_skippable=0 (0 -> 681 under --as-if-fixed), null 0 of 579 -- the same values; the local value stands and is confirmed. env_drift --all baseline wall on D3R 278.3 s (provisional).

instrumented_symbol: tests/mutation_table.py:reach_skip (and reach_problems) on tests/env_drift.py's traced baseline; tests/env_drift.py:capture_tree traced in its --capture child

perturbation.change: --as-if-fixed: hand reach_skip the capture child's own reach row in place of the refused parent row (what a hook-preserving env_drift whose git/file/uname children are read as Python-blind would deliver)

metric_definition: Count of unpinned inventory sites in the 12 cell files on an executable line the traced `env_drift.py --capture --all` child never executes, and how many of them reach_skip skips.
phenomenon_property: A ref-driven gate driver whose production-executing work happens in a child process it launches with a rebuilt environment is never reach-skippable, so the mutation lane drives it on mutants it provably cannot see.

null_control.note: Sites the capture DOES execute stay driven under both arms; the effect is confined to never-executed lines. Falsification built in: in prescreen.py's full-net `complete` drives (relaxation off), env_drift.py ran on every completed survivor whose line the capture never executes and killed none. Re-run on box D3R: null_skippable=0 of 579 under both arms.

proposed_fix_scope: tests/env_drift.py's capture launch keeps HPO_REACH_HOOK on the child's PYTHONPATH when it is set, and tests/mutation_table.py's reach_problems reads a git/file/uname child (no Python executes there) as tree-blind, as TREE_BLIND already does for `/sbin/ldconfig -p`; the null control and a pinned env_drift kill (killed_by tests/env_drift.py rows) re-verified.
